usage: Private, non-commercial fan prototype for friends. Existing local fan reference assets may be used for this private prototype; future assets should avoid official logos, downloaded original artwork and embedded readable text.

styleGuidelines.visualLanguage: Premium photo-collage board game look with Duisburg city motifs, industrial Ruhr area atmosphere, clear cream board surfaces, sharp anthracite borders and rich urban contrast.
do: Keep assets readable at small board-game tile sizes.
Leave clear blank areas for frontend-rendered text.
Keep transparent backgrounds for tokens and isolated UI assets.
avoid: Cartoon, comic, clipart or generic icon looks for future cinematic assets.
Readable text baked into generated images.
Official logos, official board game artwork or copyrighted characters.
Busy details that compete with frontend labels and prices.

masterStylePrompt: Create a premium modern Duisburg city edition board game asset for a private, non-commercial fan prototype. Visual style: cinematic photo-collage and photo-realistic city-edition look, not cartoon, comic or clipart. Use cream board surfaces (#f5eddc, #fff8ec), sharp anthracite and black borders (#252a2c, #111111), deep green accents (#0f5a3d), warm gold accents (#b8924b), muted city blue (#3d6375), event orange (#e8820c) and community green (#2d7a4f). Motifs may reference Duisburg atmosphere such as Innenhafen, Tiger & Turtle, Landschaftspark, Rhein/Ruhr water, steel, harbor culture, skyline and neighborhoods. Keep compositions high contrast, polished, readable at small board-game sizes and leave clean blank areas for frontend-rendered text. No official logos, no copyrighted characters, no downloaded original artwork, no embedded readable text.

assets.label: Spielbrett / Board Base
assets.prompt: Create a square 2D board game board base inspired by Duisburg, Germany, but do not copy Monopoly. The board should have a clean cream-colored center area and a path of empty rectangular property spaces around the edge. Use a modern cartoon style with subtle industrial Ruhr area details: harbor cranes, river waves, steel beams, brick textures and city silhouettes. No text, no numbers, no logos. Top-down view, symmetrical square board, high resolution, ready for a browser game UI.
